relationships.subject: Dasatinib and Quercetin
relationships.evidence_quote: Quantitative immunohistochemical analyses showed reductions in IL-6 and MMP13 in both D + Q and 1 y Ctr relative to the Veh group

relationships.subject: Dasatinib and Quercetin
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, both p16INK4a and p19ARF, well known markers of senescence in vivo, showed decreased abundance in D + Q-treated discs

key_findings: D + Q given from 6 or 14 months reduces age-dependent disc degeneration in mice
D + Q lowers senescence markers and SASP molecules IL-6 and MMP13
